paragraphs.text: Two hundred years ago the hills above the town were covered with apple trees. Most were cut down in the 1960s, when the fruit could not compete with imports.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: A group of residents has planted 400 young trees of old local varieties, some of which survived only in a single garden. Grafts were taken before the last trees died.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The orchard is run as a common: anyone may pick fruit for their own use, but selling it requires the group’s permission, and all pruning is done on two weekends a year.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Yields are still small. The trees will not crop fully for another decade, and late frosts in two of the last three springs destroyed most of the blossom.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: anyone may pick fruit for their own use, but selling it requires the group’s permission
items.prompt: how the rules of using the orchard work

explanation.en: The rules for using the orchard are in paragraph C.

items.quote: Most were cut down in the 1960s, when the fruit could not compete with imports

explanation.en: The orchards were cut down because of imports — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Бақтар импорт салдарынан кесілген — A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Сады вырубили из-за импорта — абзац A.

items.quote: Grafts were taken before the last trees died
items.prompt: how the old varieties were saved

explanation.en: Grafts were taken before the last trees died — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Соңғы ағаштар құрмай тұрып қалемше алынған — B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Черенки взяли до гибели последних деревьев — абзац B.

items.quote: late frosts in two of the last three springs destroyed most of the blossom
items.prompt: a natural event that reduced the harvest

explanation.en: Late frosts destroyed the blossom — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Кеш түскен үсік гүлді жойған — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Поздние заморозки погубили цвет — абзац D.
